press-feedback.rationale: Jakub exact web recipe selected for occasional pointer/touch, within Emil broad permissible0.95–0.98. Existing tokens preserved; keyboard/frequent/reduced/static opt out. Native recipe remains pending platform-specific3% ceiling, never unconditional alternate.

interruptibility.selected: Discrete CSS retargeting; continuous gestures preserve presentation value and velocity
interruptibility.rationale: Apple gesture warning is scope distinction. Controlled keyframes can interrupt but do not automatically retarget.

reduced-motion.selected: Static baseline; remove spatial motion; optional helpful nonspatial feedback
reduced-motion.rationale: Accessibility wins over pure-fade rejection and press-scale requirement. Feedback does not imply animation.

timing.rationale: Web drawer500ms/toast400ms and rare staged entrance are not general interaction budget; native toast exception excluded pending platform.

stagger.rationale: Different scopes, frequency gate first; never block interaction.

springs.rationale: Distinct default, momentum and icon scopes; no global source preference.

validation.rationale: Reconcile Apple inline-not-submit with Jakub submit validation; do not punish unfinished input.

theme.rationale: Jakub immediate switch selected over Apple global easing; explicit brightness-sensitive product treatment needs verification.

performance.selected: Prefer cheap properties and measure exceptions
performance.rationale: Do not promote blanket CSS/WAAPI/clip-path/Motion GPU claims without browser/library evidence; retain scoped accordion/visual effects.
